card.name: Word-start "Pr" in medical terms
card.fires_on: The short piece "Pr" or "pr" that begins a longer medical word, such as Prader-Willi, Prinzmetal's, prerenal or pravastatin, usually in warnings sections.

modes.label: Syndrome names
modes.description: "Pr" starts a proper eponym such as Prader-Willi or Prinzmetal's after a bullet or section number.

modes.label: Lowercase prerenal or drug name
modes.description: Lowercase "pr" begins a word like prerenal or pravastatin in running text.
